img_name.title: Image Name Settings
img_name.hash_switch_desc: Add a hash value to the image name during upload to ensure uniqueness. Highly recommended to enable.
img_name.timestamp_switch_desc: Replace the original image name with a timestamp during upload, e.g., 1716843600000.jpg. When enabled, other naming options will be turned off automatically.
img_name.prefix_switch_desc: Add a prefix to the image name during upload, for example: abc-image.jpg, where 'abc-' is the prefix.

img_compress.title: Image Compression Settings
img_compress.switch_desc: Automatically compress images before upload, reducing upload and loading times. Highly recommended to enable.

img_compress.radio_2_desc: Resulting format is jpg, highest compatibility with all browsers

img_compress.radio_4_desc: Resulting format is png, lossless optimisation preserving transparency, ideal for screenshots and graphics; photos may become larger
